params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set. Values above 100 return 400 rest_invalid_param.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to terms or users with one or more specific slugs.

items.docs: Lists users who have authored published content. This deployment returns 2 records anonymously (`X-WP-Total: 2`), each carrying `name`, `slug`, `description`, `url`, `link` and `avatar_urls` — WordPress does not expose user email addresses on this route.
